headline: CONS sector leads market lift as CNT jumps 66.3% over five days, offset by sharp sell‑offs in CONMAT.

In contrast, CONMAT is under pressure with GEL down -25.00% intraday and mixed signals from DCON. Prop and Food sectors display mixed moves and heightened trading activity, while several filings add corporate‑action risk.
